_about: SEPARATE dictionary for household / personal-care products. Never mixed with food allergen rules.

entries.name: Parabens
entries.reason: Preservatives some people prefer to avoid; can irritate sensitive skin.

entries.name: Sulfates
entries.reason: Strong detergents that can dry or irritate skin.

entries.name: Formaldehyde releasers
entries.reason: Can release formaldehyde, a known sensitiser.

entries.name: Isothiazolinones
entries.reason: Frequent cause of allergic contact dermatitis.

entries.name: Phthalates
entries.reason: Plasticisers some consumers choose to avoid.

entries.name: Triclosan
entries.reason: Antibacterial agent restricted in some markets.
